title: This Tool Turns Your Business Into Code #OpenSource#github #GitHubTrending  #DevTools

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: a GitHub project a day. Today's project is firm. Firm calls itself business as code, a textbased work management system built for technologists. Think of your company as a graph. Customers link to projects, projects linked to tasks, people linked to organizations, and you define it all in plain text files you own. No more SAS lock in. No jumping between platforms. Everything's version controlled, locally stored, and totally hackable. Firm gives you a custom DSL so your entire business becomes readable by humans and by AI agents that can query, report and automate your workflow.
